caveats: All data is SIMULATED (Stage 4/5 discrete-event emulator, virtual time, fixed link delays). Metrics say nothing about real networks.
No feature is physical radio signal strength; the simulator has no radio model.

In the emulator a handoff is an abrupt link change: the measurements contain no gradual pre-handoff degradation. Any skill above the 'always alarm' reference can only come from regularities of the experiment generator (e.g. dwell-time distribution seen through the handoff-history features), which the measurements-only ablation and the per-scenario breakdown help to expose.
Models are trained on the training split only; the validation split chooses the alarm threshold; the test split is used once for the reported numbers.
Few scenario families are held out; see the bootstrap intervals (resampling whole experiments) for the resulting uncertainty.
